variable "BUILD_DATE" {
  validation {
    condition = BUILD_DATE != ""
    error_message = "The variable 'BUILD_DATE' must not be empty."
  }
}

#######################
# BUSTER - foo latest #
#######################

target "buster-latest-build" {
  dockerfile = "Dockerfile"
  args = {
    BUILD_DATE = "${BUILD_DATE}"
    DISTRO_NAME = "buster"
    FOO_VERSION = "latest"
  }
  platforms = ["linux/amd64"]
  output    = [{ type = "docker" }]
  tags      = ["foo/latest/buster:${BUILD_DATE}"]
}

target "buster-latest-push" {
  dockerfile = "Dockerfile"
  args = {
    BUILD_DATE = "${BUILD_DATE}"
    DISTRO_NAME = "buster"
    FOO_VERSION = "latest"
  }
  platforms = ["linux/amd64"]
  output    = [{ type = "registry" }]
  tags      = [
    "registry.example.net/images/base/foo:latest-buster",
  ]
}
